user.title: Connect an S3 bucket
user.description: Point Home Assistant at an S3-compatible bucket: RustFS, Ceph, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, Backblaze B2, or AWS S3.

data_description.endpoint_url: The full base URL of your server, e.g. http://rustfs.local:9000. Leave empty only for AWS S3.
data_description.prefix: Optional folder inside the bucket to use as the root, e.g. photos/
data_description.force_path_style: Required by RustFS and most other self-hosted endpoints.

reauth_confirm.title: Update credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {bucket} are no longer accepted.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the endpoint. Check the endpoint URL, region and network access.
error.invalid_auth: The access key or secret was rejected.
error.bucket_not_found: That bucket does not exist, or the credentials cannot see it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This bucket and prefix are already configured.

data_description.use_proxy: Turn on when the endpoint is not reachable from your browser, as is usual for a self-hosted RustFS on an internal address. Turn off to let the browser fetch from the endpoint directly, which is faster and uses no Home Assistant bandwidth.
data_description.thumbnails: Thumbnails load the full image. Turn this off for folders of large photos.
data_description.url_expiry: How long a generated media link stays valid.
data_description.max_items: Folders larger than this are truncated in the browser.
